h2: NDT training near Portland: Oregon and Washington colleges, on-the-job routes and online study compared
html:
NDT training near Portland: Oregon and Washington colleges, on-the-job routes and online study compared

Portland sits between two of the Northwest's full college NDT programmes, one about 70 miles south on I-5 in Albany and one roughly 130 miles north in Lakewood, Washington. Inside the metro the choices narrow to a community college welding programme that touches on NDT, employers who hire trainees, and online study. If you searched "NDT training near me" or "NDT school near me" from Portland, this is the honest map.

Who offers NDT training around Portland?

  • Linn-Benton Community College, Albany. A two-year Associate of Applied Science in Nondestructive Testing and Evaluation, with hands-on work in phased array ultrasonics, radiography, penetrant, magnetic particle and visual inspection. It is the nearest full NDT programme we verified, and it suits someone who can commit two years and commute or move south.
  • Clover Park Technical College, Lakewood, Washington. A degree of about eight quarters covering VT, MT, PT, RT, UT and ET, with introductions to phased array and digital radiography, plus separate certificates in eddy current, MT and PT, radiography and ultrasonics of two to three quarters each. Lakewood is next to Tacoma, so for most Portlanders this means relocating.
  • Portland Community College welding. PCC lists NDT among its welding programme topics, with modular classes on morning and evening shifts at Swan Island and courses at Rock Creek and the OMIC Training Center. It is a welding programme with an NDT introduction, not method training to Level I or II.
  • On-the-job training. Marine, construction and industrial inspection contractors hire trainees and certify them as their hours build. A Portland listing reviewed for this page, from a marine inspection contractor, asked for a Level II able to perform VT, UT thickness, MT and PT, with at least two years in NDT and a year in marine service or maintenance.
  • Professional groups. ASNT's section listings include the Lewis & Clark Section in Oregon. The AWS Greater Oregon Section also holds technical meetings, including one on visual inspection of welds, useful for anyone heading toward weld inspection.

Which Portland route fits you?

Where you are nowRoute that fitsTrade-off
Starting out, able to study full timeThe Albany degree or a Lakewood certificateTwo years, or relocation for several quarters
Welder in Portland wanting an inspection rolePCC welding, then method training once an employer takes you onThe welding programme alone does not lead to NDT certification
Technician on the river or at a shipyard adding UT thickness or MTSelf-paced theory and a practical at your employerYour experience hours must still be signed off at work
Contractor certifying several techniciansTraining brought to your shop or yard to your written practiceYou need a Level III of record for the exams

Questions to ask any provider before you enrol

  • Does the record show classroom hours for each method and level that meet SNT-TC-1A's recommendations? Compare with the SNT-TC-1A hours planner.
  • Who runs the practical, and will you work on marine steel, welded plate or pipe like the work Portland employers do?
  • Who certifies you? Your employer does under its written practice; ASNT certifies only through its own central exams.
  • Will a Portland or Vancouver, Washington employer accept the training hours, or does it prefer to train in-house?
  • How do you reach an ASNT Level III with questions during the course?

Where Atlantis fits for Portland candidates and employers

Atlantis NDT has no classroom in Portland, and the route does not need one. Method theory is studied on the Atlantis portal at whatever pace your shifts allow, with an ASNT NDT Level III answering questions, and access starts the day you enrol. Scanning practice comes next in the Practical NDT simulator, then the hands-on practical and practical exam take place at your employer's yard or shop under a written practice built on SNT-TC-1A, and the employer certifies you. The marine listing above maps to UT training, MT training, PT training and VT training; newcomers can start with NDT Level 1 training.

Columbia River yards, fabricators and contractors can have training delivered on-site to a crew, with an ASNT Level III running the exams: see SNT-TC-1A training programme set-up. Weld inspectors can look at the six-day AWS CWI exam preparation for Portland. Nearby pages: Oregon, Tacoma and Seattle.
